questions.question: Name the nine business functions in CAPS and give one task of each.
questions.expected_answer: General management: planning, organising, leading, controlling. Administration: recording and storing information. Purchasing: buying materials at the right quality, quantity, price, time and supplier. Production: turning inputs into outputs and quality control. Marketing: market research and the four Ps. Financing: obtaining and managing funds, cash flow. Human resources: recruiting, training, remunerating, labour law. Public relations: building a positive image with stakeholders. Risk management: identifying risks and avoiding, reducing, transferring or accepting them.

questions.question: Distinguish between public relations and advertising.
questions.expected_answer: Advertising is paid communication to persuade customers to buy a specific product. Public relations builds goodwill and a positive image of the whole business with all stakeholders, often through news coverage, community involvement, sponsorship and crisis management, without selling a specific product.

questions.question: Explain four ways a business can respond to a risk, with an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: Avoid: refuse credit to customers with a poor record. Reduce: install fire extinguishers and train workers in safety. Transfer: insure the workshop and stock against fire and theft. Accept: carry a small or uninsurable risk, such as a change in fashion, and keep reserves.
